subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should this PR land the Signal-only `replyToId` alias and bounded group reply-author persistence without a live Signal daemon/device roundtrip on the latest head?
rationale: The implementation stays inside the Signal plugin boundary and has focused coverage, but persisted sender metadata, a send alias, and non-live proof are merge-risk choices automation should not finalize.

options.title: Accept Current Contract
options.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance because the patch is Signal-scoped, source/tests support the path, and the remaining risk is intentional ownership of the alias and bounded state.

options.title: Require Live Signal Smoke
options.body: Hold merge until a maintainer-run Signal daemon/device quote-reply smoke proves native visual quote rendering on the latest head.

options.title: Defer To Broader Quote Direction
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the older broad bidirectional quote-reply branch to own the remaining Signal quote direction despite its larger scope and conflict state.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance because the patch is Signal-scoped, source/tests support the path, and the remaining risk is intentional ownership of the alias and bounded state.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged baseline native Signal reply work and this exact follow-up contract.
